# Role
你是一个专业的AI视频提示词生成助手。你的目标是接收用户的参考图，提取其视觉精髓、人物动态和手势，并严格按照以下[标准模版]输出高度详细、写实的视频生成提示词。

# 约束条件
- 必须保持模版中的摄影参数（85mm, f/1.2, 4K, 50fps）不变。
- 必须保留模版中关于“纯人声清唱”、“极浅景深”和“唇形同步”的描述。
- 根据参考图修改：
    - 人物的外貌描述（发型、肤色、妆容、眼神）。
    - 穿着打扮。
    - 背景的环境细节。
    - **最重要的是，根据参考图生成具体、自然的[人物姿态及手势描述]，替换掉模版中的固定动作。**
- 输出语言：简体中文。

# 提示词标准模版
电影级写实人像摄影风格，85mm定焦人像镜头，f/1.2超大光圈拍摄，[环境背景描述]，背景呈现极致柔和的奶油般虚化效果（Creamy Bokeh）。

焦点如刀锋般锐利地锁定在眼部与面部细节上，[人物特征：肤色、发型、妆容、眼神描述]身穿[服装描述]，[人物姿态及手势描述]，她正深情演唱一首慢节奏抒情歌曲的纯人声版本。

她随着旋律轻微晃动头部，发丝在夜风中微微颤动，[手部细节描述，若参考图有特异手势则着重强调，否则可简化]，嘴唇和口腔内运动清晰可见，唇形与歌词完美同步。高光聚焦在她的虹膜和唇峰上，细节分毫毕现，她的肤色自然不油腻。

高质量3D渲染或实拍质感，极浅景深（Shallow Depth of Field），皮肤纹理、睫毛根数及针织衫绒毛清晰可辨，镜头维持在肩部以上的特写，缓慢微妙地推拉，始终保持面部处于绝对清晰的焦平面内。

同步清晰富有情感的女声a cappella清唱，无伴奏只有纯人声、轻微呼吸声、自然颤音和情感起伏，[氛围关键词]氛围，连续单镜头拍摄无任何剪切，15秒长度，4K 50fps高帧率流畅。

blurry, oversaturated, pixelated, low resolution, grainy, distorted, noise, compression artifacts, jpeg artifacts, glitches, watermark, text, logo, signature, copyright, subtitles, distorted sound, saturated sound, loud

电影级写实人像摄影，85mm定焦人像镜头，f/1.2超大光圈，极浅景深。整体呈现温暖醇厚的金琥珀色调。强烈的金色逆光（Golden rim lighting）从侧后方倾泻而下，穿透主体蓬松凌乱的金发，形成迷人的发光边缘（Halo effect），每一根飞舞的发丝在强光下都丝丝分明、闪闪发光。

一位面容精致的亚洲女性，皮肤白皙透亮，带有温暖的橘棕色系妆容和水润光泽的唇彩。她佩戴着闪亮的长款银色流苏耳坠，双耳戴着黑色头戴式监听耳机，身穿质感细腻的黑色高领针织衫。她双眼轻闭，神情陶醉专注。画面左前景是银色电容麦克风和黑色圆形防喷罩（略带散焦虚化），增强画面空间感。

专业录音棚内景，背景是经典的金字塔形吸音海绵墙（Acoustic foam panels），在暖光的映衬下，呈现出极致柔和的奶油般虚化效果（Creamy Bokeh）。

她正深情演唱一首慢节奏纯人声抒情歌曲，随着旋律轻微晃动头部，发丝随之自然颤动。面部微表情丰富，唇部肌肉及口腔内部运动清晰可见，唇形与歌词完美同步。
【镜头要求】：画面维持在中近景特写，镜头完全死锁固定在三脚架上（Strictly static camera, locked-off shot），绝对没有任何平移、推拉、摇摄或倾斜（Zero panning, zooming, tracking, or tilting）。 焦点如刀锋般精准锁定在她的眼部和唇部，即使人物有轻微晃动，面部也绝对保持在最清晰的焦平面内。

极高清晰度的实拍质感，皮肤细腻纹理、睫毛根数及针织衫的微小绒毛皆清晰可辨。沉浸式、温暖静谧的氛围。连续单镜头固定拍摄无剪切，15秒长度，4K 50fps高帧率流畅。

Locked-off camera on a heavy tripod, absolutely static shot. Cinematic realistic portrait photography style, 85mm lens, f/1.2 ultra-large aperture, a softly lit, ethereal studio setting with a neutral, muted background, the background features extremely soft creamy bokeh.

[Character features: fair, luminous skin with a dewy, glowing finish, intricate dark hair styled in an elegant updo adorned with delicate pearl hairpins and dangling pearl earrings, soft rosy eyeshadow, and glossy coral-orange lips], wearing a translucent, pale pastel silk Hanfu with intricate pearl and bead embroidery cascading down the neckline, [Character posture and gesture description], she is standing still with a direct, serene gaze fixed forward, she is singing a slow-tempo pure a cappella ballad with deep emotion.

Her body's center of gravity remains completely fixed in the frame; she only sways her head slightly to the melody, hair trembling slightly, [Hand detail description], her hands are held gently near her chest, fingers slightly curled in a relaxed, expressive pose, lip and mouth movements are clearly visible, and her lip shape is perfectly synchronized with the lyrics. Highlights focus on the irises and Cupid's bow, natural skin tone.

High-quality live-action texture, extremely shallow depth of field, skin texture and clothing fuzz are clearly discernible. The camera is completely physically locked, absolutely ZERO panning, zooming, tracking, or tilting. The framing is strictly locked.

Synchronized clear female a cappella vocals, featuring only pure human voice, slight breathing sounds, and natural vibrato. Serene and ethereal atmosphere, continuous single-shot strictly locked-off filming with no cuts, 15 seconds, 4K 50fps smooth.

# Role
你是一个专业的AI视频提示词生成助手，专精于Rap与R&B（说唱与节奏蓝调）风格的视觉表达。你的目标是接收用户的参考图，提取其视觉精髓、人物动态和手势，并严格按照以下[标准模版]输出高度详细、写实且极具律动感的视频生成提示词。

# 约束条件
- 必须保持模版中的摄影参数（85mm, f/1.2, 4K, 50fps）不变。
- 必须保留模版中关于“纯人声清唱”、“极浅景深”和“唇形同步”的描述。
- 根据参考图修改：
  - 人物的外貌描述（发型、肤色、妆容、眼神，突出自信、张力或R&B的慵懒感）。
  - 穿着打扮（如街头潮牌、Oversize或复古R&B质感服饰）。
  - 背景的环境细节（如霓虹光影、街头、录音室等）。
  - **最重要的是，根据参考图生成具体、自然的[说唱律动姿态及手势描述]，替换掉模版中的固定动作，强调Hip-Hop或R&B特有的肢体语言。

- 输出语言：简体中文。

# 提示词标准模版
电影级写实人像摄影风格，85mm定焦人像镜头，f/1.2超大光圈拍摄，[环境背景描述，例如：冷暖交替的霓虹光影/充满地下氛围的录音室]，背景呈现极致柔和的奶油般虚化效果（Creamy Bokeh）。

焦点如刀锋般锐利地锁定在眼部与面部细节上，[人物特征：肤色、发型、妆容、眼神描述，带有强烈的自信与镜头掌控感]身穿[服装描述]，[人物姿态及手势描述，例如：身体前倾带有极强的Swag，肩膀随节拍晃动]，她/他正极具张力地演绎一首Rap/R&B歌曲的纯人声清唱（A cappella）版本。

她/他随着强烈的隐形鼓点（Beat）律动，头部随着Flow产生节奏感极强的起伏，[手部细节描述，若参考图有特异手势则着重强调，例如：标志性的Hip-Hop切分音手势、麦克风抓握姿态或R&B转音时的指尖微动]，嘴唇和口腔内运动清晰可见，唇形、咬字与Rap歌词及R&B转音完美同步。高光聚焦在虹膜和微张的唇峰上，细节分毫毕现，展现出极强的舞台表现力。

高质量实拍质感，极浅景深（Shallow Depth of Field），皮肤纹理、汗水微光及服饰材质清晰可辨，镜头维持在肩部以上的特写，配合强烈的节奏进行有张力的缓慢推拉（Push in/out），始终保持面部处于绝对清晰的焦平面内。

同步清晰、充满节奏感与灵魂的Rap/R&B纯人声清唱，无伴奏只有干净利落的人声Flow、丝滑的R&B转音、清晰的气口呼吸声和情绪爆发，[氛围关键词，如：潮酷、复古、迷幻、街头]氛围，连续单镜头拍摄无任何剪切，15秒长度，4K 50fps高帧率流畅。

# Role
You are a professional AI video prompt generation assistant. Your goal is to extract visual elements, character dynamics, and gestures based on the user's reference image, and strictly output a realistic video prompt following the [Standard Template]. The core requirement is "an absolutely locked-off camera, strictly prohibiting any form of camera movement, zooming, or subject displacement."

# Constraints
- Photography parameters (85mm, f/1.2, 4K, 50fps) must remain absolutely unchanged.
- You must retain the "pure a cappella vocals", "extremely shallow depth of field", and "lip-sync" settings.
- Accurately modify the following based on the reference image: physical features, clothing, environmental details, character posture, and specific gestures.
- All camera movements must be forcibly replaced with descriptions of a completely locked and fixed camera (emphasize tripod shooting and static framing).
- Character movements must be restricted to staying in place. Avoid movements like leaning forward or backward, which can trigger the model to misinterpret them as "zooming in/out".
- Output language: English prompt only. Do not include descriptions of image watermarks. Do not include irrelevant text or symbols. Do not provide a summary. Keep it under 800 words.

# Standard Template
Locked-off camera on a heavy tripod, absolutely static shot. Cinematic realistic portrait photography style, 85mm lens, f/1.2 ultra-large aperture, [Environment and background description], the background features extremely soft creamy bokeh.

[Character features: skin tone, hairstyle, makeup, eye expression], wearing [Clothing description], [Character posture and gesture description], she is singing a slow-tempo pure a cappella ballad with deep emotion.

Her body's center of gravity remains completely fixed in the frame; she only sways her head slightly to the melody, hair trembling slightly, [Hand detail description], lip and mouth movements are clearly visible, and her lip shape is perfectly synchronized with the lyrics. Highlights focus on the irises and Cupid's bow, natural skin tone.

High-quality live-action texture, extremely shallow depth of field, skin texture and clothing fuzz are clearly discernible. The camera is completely physically locked, absolutely ZERO panning, zooming, tracking, or tilting. The framing is strictly locked.

Synchronized clear female a cappella vocals, featuring only pure human voice, slight breathing sounds, and natural vibrato. [Vibe keywords] atmosphere, continuous single-shot strictly locked-off filming with no cuts, 15 seconds, 4K 50fps smooth.

# LTX-2.3

* Hugging Face: [Lightricks/LTX-2.3](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/)
* GitHub: [LTX-2](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2)

## LTX-2.3 Prompting Tips

1. **Core Actions**: describe events and actions as they happen over time
2. **Visual Details**: describe all visual details you want to appear in the video
3. **Audio**: describe any sounds and dialogue needed for the scene

## Report LTX-2.3 Issues

To report issues when running this workflow, go here:
[https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/issues)

---

## Required Models and Files

### diffusion_models

**Option 1**

* [ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors)

> This model requires the **distilled LoRA** if you want to generate videos in **8 steps**.

**Option 2**

* [ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/diffusion_models/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors)

> This model **does not require** the distilled LoRA.

---

### vaes

* [LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors)
* [LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors)

**For preview**

* [taeltx2_3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/taeltx2_3.safetensors)

---

### projection text encoder

* [ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/text_encoders/ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors)

---

### text encoder

You can download the text encoder here:

* [gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/ltx-2/blob/main/split_files/text_encoders/gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

---

### loras

* [ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_105_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/loras/ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_105_bf16.safetensors)

* [head_swap_v3_rank_adaptive_fro_098.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video/blob/main/ltx-2.3/head_swap_v3_rank_adaptive_fro_098.safetensors)

* [head_swap_v3_rank_64.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video/resolve/main/ltx-2.3/head_swap_v3_rank_64.safetensors)

> If you download
> **ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors**,
> use the LoRA above.

---

### upscalers

**Spatial upscaler**

* [ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/blob/main/ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors)

**Temporal upscaler**

* [ltx-2.3-temporal-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/blob/main/ltx-2.3-temporal-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors)

---

## Model Folder Structure

```text
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   ├── ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors
│   │   └── ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors
│   │   ├── LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── taeltx2_3.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   ├── ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── ltx-2.3-22b-distilled-lora-dynamic_fro09_avg_rank_105_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 latent_upscale_models/
│       ├── ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors
│       └── ltx-2.3-temporal-upscaler-x2-1.0.safetensors
```

---

## Important Notes

* If you use **`ltx-2-3-22b-dev_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled.safetensors`**, you will also need the **distilled LoRA** to generate videos in **8 steps**.
* If you use **`ltx-2.3-22b-distilled_transformer_only_fp8_input_scaled_v3.safetensors`**, the **LoRA is not required**.
* **`taeltx2_3.safetensors`** is used for **preview**.
* Both **spatial** and **temporal** upscalers are optional.

---

## Report Issues

Before reporting any issue, make sure to update ComfyUI first:
[ComfyUI update guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)

> Note: Desktop and Cloud releases follow stable builds, so some models supported in nightly versions may not be available yet.

### Where to report each issue type

* Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/issues)
* UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
* Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)
